text.text: Minior (Green Core) , the Meteor Pokémon, will make its Pokémon GO debut during the Orionids meteor shower, beginning October 19, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. local time !

Minior has seven different core colors: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, and Violet . A different core color will debut during each of the six meteor showers listed below. During the Geminids, one core color will debut in the Northern Hemisphere and a
Green Core Minior debuts during the Orionids. The core colors for the remaining meteor showers have not been announced.
Minior’s Form Changes
Initially, Minior will only be able to change forms when battling Team GO Rocket, team leaders, or in the GO Battle League.
Minior will not be eligible for the 2027 Latin America International Championships .

Timed Research will be available during the event. Claim a Star Piece , then complete five Use a Star Piece tasks to earn 7,740 Stardust each. Complete all tasks to earn an additional 77,400 Stardust .

text.text: GO Pass: Into the Wild is a free progression track. Complete Pass Tasks to collect GO Points, increase your rank, and unlock rewards.
Trainers will receive the pass automatically on Monday, November 9, at 10:00 a.m. local time . Earn points and rank up until Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. local time .
From Monday, November 9, to Friday, November 13, you can collect GO Points up to a daily cap. There’s no limit to the GO Points you can earn on Saturday and Sunday, November 14 to 15!
Upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: Into the Wild for US$14.99 * for upgraded rewards. The GO Pass Deluxe: Into the Wild + 10 Ranks option costs US$19.99 * and grants enough GO Points to reach Rank 10.
Deluxe includes rewards from both tracks. You can upgrade at any time and still claim rewards for ranks you have already reached.

text.text: The following bonuses will be active during the event.
Max Particles cannot be obtained from catches with the Explorer Gadget or a Pokémon GO Plus +.
All Dynamax Pokémon that have previously appeared in Pokémon GO may appear in Max Battles during the event, excluding Legendary and Mythical Pokémon.
Special Background

After successfully catching a Pokémon from a Max Battle during the event, Trainers will have a chance to receive a Special Background. It appears on the Pokémon’s summary page to commemorate when it was caught.

Trainers cannot catch Eternamax Eternatus after defeating it in Max Battles. Instead, they will earn a large amount of Eternatus Candy and Eternatus Candy XL to power up Eternatus obtained through GO Pass: Dynamax Trails.
During this window, Power Spots will refresh more frequently, the Max Particle collection limit will increase to 2,400, and Power Spots will award 8× Max Particles.
The daily Remote Raid limit will increase from 10 to 30 from November 20 at 1 pm to November 21 at 6 pm PST (GMT −8).

text.text: GO Pass is a free, limited-time progression track. Collect GO Points and complete Pass Tasks to rank up and earn rewards.
Trainers who claim Tier 1 rewards (Rank 25) on GO Pass: Into the Wild will receive early access on November 14, 2026, at 10 am local time, and a free upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: Dynamax Trails .

GO Pass Deluxe is also available for US$4.99 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency), offering upgraded rewards and faster progression. Deluxe Trainers can claim rewards from both tracks, including rewards from ranks unlocked before upgrading.
Claim all unlocked rewards by November 25, 2026, at 8 pm local time , before they expire.

Eternatus can only be caught once during this event and requires much more Candy and Candy XL to power up due to its massive power. Trainers who have already caught Eternatus will receive Candy to continue powering it up.
